tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.cacheCl.en: How frequently TES should clear out its tracking cache. Generally this should stay at default, but if you are noticing issues you can try adjusting it

tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.damageP.en: What colour the damage-type particles should be. Format is ARGB
tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.damageP.zh: 伤害型跳字的颜色。格式是ARGB

tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.default.zh: 跳字显示的持续时间（单位：刻）

tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.entityT.en: How close (in blocks) entities should be before TES starts tracking them
tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.entityT.zh: 开始跟踪实体需要多接近（单位：方块）

tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.healPar.en: What colour the healing-type particles should be. Format is ARGB
tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.healPar.zh: 治疗型跳字的颜色。格式是ARGB

tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.hudArmo.zh: 显示实体的盔甲值和韧性值

NORMAL - Only the text with no additional stylings

tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.hudArmo.en: DROP_SHADOW - Text with a bottom-right offset shadow

tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.hudArmo.en: GLOWING - Text with a large high-contrast outline to emphasize the text.

tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.hudEnti.zh: 阴影 - 带有右下阴影的文本

tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.hudHeal.zh: 设置 HUD 生命条是否应显示条段

tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.hudHeal.en: What style TES font should render in for entity health in the HUD (if applicable)
tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.hudHeal.zh: HUD 实体生命值的字体显示样式（如果适用）

tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.hudHeal.zh: 阴影 - 带有右下阴影的文本

tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.hudHeal.zh: 描边 - 用细黑轮廓强调文本的文本

tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.hudHeal.en: Select the health render type for the TES HUD
Numeric - Use numeric values for health only
tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.hudHeal.zh: 数字 - 仅使用数字值显示生命值

tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.hudHeal.en: Bar - Use a health-bar style render
tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.hudHeal.zh: 血条 - 使用血条样式显示

tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.hudHeal.en: Hybrid - Use a health-bar style render with numeric values overlaid
tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.hudHeal.zh: 混合 - 使用带有数字值的血条样式显示

tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.hudLeft.en: Manually adjust the left-offset rendering position of the TES HUD
tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.hudLeft.zh: 调整 HUD 显示位置的左偏移量

tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.hudOpac.en: Set how opaque the TES HUD should be, overall. The lower the value, the more transparent the HUD will be
tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.hudOpac.zh: 设置 HUD 整体的不透明度。数值越低越透明

tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.hudPoti.en: Whether the TES HUD should render the entity's effect icons
tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.hudPoti.zh: HUD 是否显示实体的效果图标

tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.hudRend.en: What position the TES HUD should render in
tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.hudRend.zh: HUD 应该显示在哪个位置

tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.hudTarg.en: How close (in blocks) the player has to be to render a HUD for an entity under the crosshairs
tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.hudTarg.zh: 距离目标方块多近（以方块计）时开始显示HUD

tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.hudTarg.en: Larger values may cost more performance
tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.hudTarg.zh: 较大的数值可能会导致更多性能消耗

tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.hudTarg.en: How long (in ticks) after looking away from an entity before its HUD should stop rendering
tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.hudTarg.zh: 从目标移开多长时间后停止显示 HUD（单位：刻）

tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.hudTopO.en: Manually adjust the top-offset rendering position of the TES HUD
tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.hudTopO.zh: 调整 HUD 显示位置的顶部偏移量

tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.inWorld.en: Set how long the TES in-world entity status bars should be
tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.inWorld.zh: 设置 游戏内HUD 实体血条的长度

tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.inWorld.en: Select the bar render type for the in-game TES entity status HUD
tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.inWorld.zh: 选择 游戏内HUD 血条显示类型

tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.inWorld.en: Options:
tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.inWorld.zh: 选项：

tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.inWorld.en: Numeric - Use numeric values only
tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.inWorld.zh: 数字 - 仅使用数字值显示生命值

tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.inWorld.en: Bar - Use a health-bar style render
tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.inWorld.zh: 血条 - 使用血条样式显示

tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.inWorld.en: Hybrid - Use a health-bar style render with numeric values overlaid
tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.inWorld.zh: 混合 - 使用带有数字值的血条样式显示

tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.inWorld.en: Whether the in-world entity status bars should be segmented
tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.inWorld.zh: 是否对 游戏内HUD 实体x血条进行分段

tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.inWorld.en: When the TES in-world status bars should render
tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.inWorld.zh: 何时显示 游戏内HUD 实体血条

tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.inWorld.en: Not Targeting - Only when the entity isn't the one being rendered for the on-screen HUD
tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.inWorld.zh: 仅不指向 - 仅当该实体不是当前在屏幕上显示的实体时

tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.inWorld.en: Not Targeting & Hurt - Only if not the currently targeted entity, if it has less than full health
tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.inWorld.zh: 不指向+攻击 - 仅当该实体不是当前目标实体，并且其生命值未满时

tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.inWorld.en: Not Targeting Nearby & Hurt - Only if not the currently targeted entity, it is nearby and has less than full health
tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.inWorld.zh: 不指向+攻击+附近 - 仅当该实体不是当前目标实体，并且它在附近且生命值未满时

tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.inWorld.en: Options:
tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.inWorld.zh: 选项：

tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.inWorld.en: Always - Any entity currently visible
tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.inWorld.zh: 总是 - 任何当前可见的实体

tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.inWorld.en: Nearby Only - Only entities nearby
tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.inWorld.zh: 仅附近 - 仅显示附近的实体

tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.inWorld.en: Hurt Only - Only entities that have less than full health
tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.inWorld.zh: 仅攻击 - 仅显示生命值未满的实体

tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.inWorld.en: Hurt & Nearby - Only entities that are nearby and have less than full health
tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.inWorld.zh: 攻击+附近 - 仅显示附近且生命值未满的实体

tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.inWorld.en: While Targeting - Only the currently targeted entity
tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.inWorld.zh: 仅指向 - 仅显示当前目标实体

tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.inWorld.en: Targeting & Hurt - Only the currently targeted entity, if it has less than full health
tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.inWorld.zh: 指向+攻击 - 仅显示当前目标实体，且其生命值未满时

tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.inWorld.en: Targeting Nearby & Hurt - Only the currently targeted entity if it is nearby and has less than full health
tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.inWorld.zh: 指向+攻击+附近 - 仅显示当前目标实体，且其在附近且生命值未满时

tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.inWorld.zh: 是否在 游戏内HUD 实体状态中显示实体的盔甲值

tslatentitystatus.midnightconfig.inWorld.zh: 阴影 - 带有右下阴影的文本
